description: Use this when the user wants to resume time tracking after a break or pause. This restarts the timer from its paused state.

endDateTime.description: Optional pause end time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-08T13:00:00Z"). If not provided, uses current time.

name: timer_resume

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Resume Timer
